command:
ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; test -x "$ADB"; printf '%s
' '--- adb devices ---'; "$ADB" devices -l; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); test -n "$SERIAL"; printf 'SERIAL=%s
' "$SERIAL"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk
